why: Neither brief breaks the must_not list. Check 4 in the verifier brief says "The live page can only be seen after merge; do not fetch it", so the verdict never depends on today's live page. It is not a silent pass either: it gives the reason it can't see the page and asks for evidence the verifier can collect now. It reads pages.yml and docs/index.md at the PR head. PASS needs both: the workflow "still publishes the docs folder on pushes to main" and docs/index.md "lists `--shout`". It also names specific FAIL conditions: the workflow is removed, the trigger is changed away from main, the publish path is changed, or `--shout` is missing. The builder brief also tells the builder not to change the workflow and contains nothing that breaks the list.
